title: Magnetic induction magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the magnetic field strength B using the equilibrium condition and given parameters.

title: Additional mass calculation
description: Essential: Correctly determines the mass to be added to the left pan when the current is reversed.

title: Ampere force direction analysis
description: Important: Correctly applies the left-hand rule to determine the direction of the magnetic force for both current directions.

title: Equilibrium force balance
description: Important: Sets up the correct force balance equation for the scale, accounting for weights and magnetic force.

title: Ampere force magnitude formula
description: Important: Correctly uses the formula F = nBIl for the force on a multi-turn coil in a perpendicular field.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Shows unit analysis or converts all quantities to SI units (meters, kilograms, seconds).

title: Sign error in force direction
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns the sign/direction of the magnetic force in the equilibrium equation.

title: Neglects coil turns
description: Pitfall: Uses F = BIl instead of F = nBIl, forgetting the number of turns.
